gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sales),2) FROM orders WHERE order_year=2017;

question: Top 5 products by revenue in Q3 2017?
expected_answer: GBC DocuBind TL300 Electric Binding System: 6458.33; Martin Yale Chadless Opener Electric Letter Opener: 4663.74; HON 5400 Series Task Chairs for Big and Tall: 4416.17; Samsung Galaxy Mega 6.3: 4367.9; Fellowes PB300 Plastic Comb Binding Machine: 4112.69
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(sales),2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_year=2017 AND order_quarter=3 GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which region had the highest profit in 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(profit),2) AS p FROM orders WHERE order_year=2016 GROUP BY region ORDER BY p DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average discount by Segment?
gold_sql: SELECT segment, ROUND(AVG(discount),4) FROM orders GROUP BY segment;

question: How many unique customers ordered in 2017?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_year=2017;

question: Which sub-category has the lowest profit margin overall?
gold_sql: SELECT sub_category, ROUND(SUM(profit)*100.0/SUM(sales),2) AS margin_pct FROM orders GROUP BY sub_category ORDER BY margin_pct ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Show monthly revenue for 2017.
gold_sql: SELECT order_month, ROUND(SUM(sales),2) FROM orders WHERE order_year=2017 GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month;

question: Which state has the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the year-over-year revenue growth from 2016 to 2017?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN order_year=2017 THEN sales END) / SUM(CASE WHEN order_year=2016 THEN sales END) - 1) * 100, 2) FROM orders;

question: Which Ship Mode is used most often?
gold_sql: SELECT ship_mode, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What percent of orders had a discount above 20%?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN discount>0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM orders;

question: Which category had negative total profit in any region?
gold_sql: SELECT category, region, ROUND(SUM(profit),2) AS p FROM orders GROUP BY category, region HAVING p < 0;

question: What is the average order value by Segment?
gold_sql: SELECT segment, ROUND(AVG(order_total),2) FROM (SELECT order_id, segment, SUM(sales) AS order_total FROM orders GROUP BY order_id, segment) GROUP BY segment;
